notes:
Bucks County (excluding the New Hope–Upper Black Eddy riverfront). Bands only: solo singer-songwriters, DJs, open mics/jams, school/youth and community concert bands, comedy and films were dropped. Duos kept. Names lightly normalized across venues (e.g. 'Big Chill' -> 'Big Chill Band', 'Far Away Guys' -> 'Faraway Guys'); Vault Brewing leader-named groups that switch between duo/trio (Tom Trovas, Behn Gillece, Suzette Ortiz) are merged under one name each.
Sources: Puck and Broken Goblet from every event page in their Wix event sitemaps (Broken Goblet: 60 of 1,103 pages failed on rate limits) (Puck's sitemap only reaches back to Jul 2025); Sellersville Theater from its paginated archive and upcoming pages (theater dominated by national touring and tribute acts; ~370 band-dates); Vault Brewing via Squarespace JSON; Bucks County Brewery and Aristaeus via The Events Calendar REST API; Free Will Brewing from 5 Wayback snapshots plus the live page (only shows ~2 months ahead, so gaps remain); Newtown Theatre from one Wayback snapshot (Apr–Nov 2025) plus live JSON (Aug–Dec 2026); Doylestown Arts Festival (2025 via Wayback, 2026 live) and Doylestown Porchfest (2025 PDF, 2026 printed schedule image) complete; park series mostly from press round-ups (Levittown Now) and township pages.
Not reached / no data: Tranquility Brewing (Cloudflare), Rose Bank Winery (rate-limited, JS calendar), Penn Community Bank Amphitheater (site blocks scripts), Reese's Tavern and Bandsintown/Indie on the Move (403), Lower Bucks Times Aug 2026 bar guide (403, used via search snippets only). Bars with no online calendars (Gleason's, McStew's, Maxwell's on Main, 86 West, Red Stallion, McCoole's, Brick Tavern, Proper Brewing) are listed without appearances. Funky Lil Kitchen and Mesquito Grille could not be verified as music venues. Newtown PorchStock (first held Sep 27 2025) had no published lineup. Langhorne Porch Fest 2026 (Oct 10, 17 bands) schedule exists only as an image that wasn't published. Temperance House's weekly Thursday blues residency (Steve Guyger & Filthy Rich) has no per-date rows. Bristol Riverside Theatre's multi-day concert-style tribute productions were not recorded as band dates. Year inference: Free Will and Temperance pages omit the year; weekday checks were used (e.g. Free Will 'Saturday, October 24' = 2026).
Data comes from single-venue calendars: a band with one date may well play elsewhere in the area unrecorded. The web-search budget was used up (~35), so social-media snippet sweeps for bars were not done.
